name: EEF European Heavyweight Championship
caption: The fed's own top title; won by Josef "The Cavalier" Tadeuscz in a 15-man tournament at The Grand European, vacant by December, then won by "Normal" Klaus Lehman in a twelve-man battle royal at Survival of the Fittest.
epitaph: EEF European Heavyweight Championship of EEF: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: EEF German Championship
caption: Held by "Classic" Andrew Archer; a rival claimant bills himself the 'Real GERMAN CHAMPION' by December, a disputed lineage carried not resolved.

name: EEF Tag Team Championship
caption: First won by The Monarchy, beating the Italian Stallions in the Grand European final.

name: EEF Transcontinental Championship
caption: A fourth EEF belt, named in the December PPV's own roll-call; no reign is attested in the held record.
